originalText: Where each hook runs in one agent loop

text:
- Node hooks: before_agent, before_model,
  after_model, after_agent (update state)
- Wrap hooks: wrap_model_call, wrap_tool_call
  (call the handler 0, 1 or many times)
- [m1, m2, m3]: before in order, after in
  reverse, wraps nest (m1 outermost)
- jump_to: end, tools, model
